messages:
maria (Docs): Quick heads-up — PR #4821 updates the audit-logs page with retention TTL examples for SDKs. Need eyes from @josh and @sam. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821
josh (Security): Thanks, Maria. Quick scan: wording around 'tenant-owned data' needs to align with SOC2 evidence language. Can you paste the proposed legal phrase?
maria (Docs): Sure — "Redwood stores audit logs for the duration specified by the tenant's retention policy; export and deletion requests are honored per contract and applicable law." Is that ok?
sam (Legal): Suggest swap 'honored' -> 'processed' and add 'subject to lawful holds' — so: "...export and deletion requests are processed, subject to lawful holds and contractual obligations."
maria (Docs): Got it, will update. Also need a code snippet porting cURL export example to Python and Node SDKs. Current cURL in docs:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?since=2024-01-01"
```
mina (DevEx): I can do python + ts snippets. One question: should samples mention pagination? We have streaming export, maybe show chunked example.
josh (Security): yes show pagination param `page_token` and `format=jsonl` (and mention `page_size` for batch guidance).
mina (DevEx): OK will add both. PR link above.
ryan (Eng): small nit — the SDK sample in the PR uses `client.export_audit_logs` but actual method in v0.9 SDK is `client.audit.export`. Please confirm.
maria (Docs): Good catch, Ryan. I'll update to `client.audit.export` and add a compatibility note for v0.8 -> v0.9.
sam (Legal): LGTM from legal side once phrase updated. maria, add me as reviewer on that PR.
maria (Docs): Adding you now. Also adding an example JSONL snippet and clarifying default TTL units (use ISO 8601 / explicit units). Example I added: 
```jsonl
{"timestamp":"2024-01-02T12:00:00Z","event":"login","user_id":"acct_123"}
```
mina (DevEx): I'll convert the cURL to the SDK examples like:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=TOKEN)
for chunk in client.audit.export(since='2024-01-01', format='jsonl', page_size=100):
    print(chunk)
```
and TS
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: TOKEN });
for await (const page of client.audit.export({ since: '2024-01-01', format: 'jsonl', page_size: 100 })) {
  console.log(page);
}
```
ryan (Eng): also leaving an inline comment re: example retention TTL value — suggest `P90D` (ISO 8601 duration) instead of plain text like `3 months` for machine clarity.
maria (Docs): Done. Reworded legal phrasing per Sam and switched TTLs to ISO durations. Pushed update to the PR and added unit tests for snippet rendering.
mina (DevEx): Posted updated snippets in PR comment. Also added a short note on streaming export caveats (connection timeouts & retry guidance).
sam (Legal): Reviewed and approved wording. Minor suggestion: replace 'tenant' with 'customer' in the public-facing doc.
maria (Docs): Replaced 'tenant' -> 'customer' in the doc and in SDK example comments. Merging once CI passes. Thanks all :raised_hands:
